metadata:
Package: aconsole
Version: 0.1.1
Architecture: amd64
Maintainer: AConsole <noreply@aconsole.invalid>
Section: devel
Priority: optional
Depends: git, podman, gir1.2-gtk-4.0 (>= 4.14), gir1.2-adw-1 (>= 1.5), gir1.2-vte-3.91, libgirepository-2.0-0, libcairo2, libcairo-gobject2, libffi8
Description: Agents Console: run CLI coding agents side by side
 Carries its own Python 3.15 under /opt.

probes.stdout:
usage: python -m aconsole [-h]
                          [--fake {demo,empty,stress,errors,waiting,quota-critical,approval-expired,agents}]
                          [--socket SOCKET]
                          [--snapshot-view {window,tabs,plan-graph,review,git,quota-dialog,quota-account,palette,setup,prefs}]
                          [--theme {light,dark}] [--size SIZE] [--out OUT]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --fake, --fake-core {demo,empty,stress,errors,waiting,quota-critical,approval-expired,agents}
  --socket SOCKET
  --snapshot-view {window,tabs,plan-graph,review,git,quota-dialog,quota-account,palette,setup,prefs}
  --theme {light,dark}
  --size SIZE
  --out OUT

usage: python -m aconsole.core --fake SCENARIO [--socket PATH]
       python -m aconsole.core --serve [--socket PATH] [--allow-gil]

limitation: Extracted payload only. No dpkg/apt install, maintainer scripts or desktop integration acceptance.
